name: Metaproscaline
summary: Metaproscaline (MP), also known as 3,4-dimethoxy-5-propoxyphenethylamine, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the derivative of mescaline in which the methoxy group at the 3 position has been replaced with a propoxy group. In addition, it is a positional isomer of proscaline.

fact.en: Metaproscaline is proscaline with its propoxy group moved from the middle of the ring to one side, in the same way metaescaline relates to escaline. Shulgin described it in PiHKAL.
fact.zh: Metaproscaline 是把普羅斯卡林的丙氧基從環的中間移到一側，就像 metaescaline 與愛斯卡林的關係一樣。舒爾金在《PiHKAL》中描述過它。
fact.zhHans: Metaproscaline 是把普罗斯卡林的丙氧基从环的中间移到一侧，就像 metaescaline 与爱斯卡林的关系一样。舒尔金在《PiHKAL》中描述过它。
